snippet.title: Skateboard Knight - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061730/

Casually save the world on a skateboard!
The controls are simple: just move up and down to pick a lane. Horizontal movement and attacks are all automatic!

The action RPG-esque roguelite Skateboard Knight will be published by PLAYISM!

Developer: Maroru Games
Publisher: PLAYISM
